title: W9 re-pin leaves MIN_LAND at 95% of the OLD single-entry surge ask — now ~47.5% of the real 20/tick ask, and campus surge non-landing is undetectable
evidence: core/demand_test.odin:512-514: `EXPECTED := 10 * WINDOW // the re-tuned surge: ×10 the era-3 streaming base (1/tick)` and `MIN_LAND := EXPECTED * 95 / 100`; data/demand.json era 3 now holds TWO streaming entries (`source_role: content_host ... volume: 1` and `source_role: campus ... volume: 1`); core/demand.odin:72-80 effective_volume multiplies each entry: `v := base; for idx in plan.active_sp { sp := &plan.era_sp[idx]; if sp.class == class { v *= sp.multiplier } }`; core/demand_test.odin:585-587 crowd floor: `testing.expectf(t, hosts >= 8, "growth must place >= 8 streaming-capable terminals (content_hosts + campuses) by the surge window (got %d) — the aggregation crowd", hosts)`
detail: The 5.11 campus entry doubles the surge ask to 20/tick (2 entries x10), but EXPECTED stays 10*WINDOW, so MIN_LAND is now ~47.5% of the ask. A regression where campuses never source during the surge still passes W9 (hosts alone meet the floor), contradicting the PR claim 'the x10 surge lands on campuses too' and the test header 'silent non-landing is a fail'.
recommended_fix: Re-derive EXPECTED as (entries x base x multiplier) x WINDOW (20*WINDOW) or add a per-role surge-landing floor (campus spawns > 0 in-window); update the header comment '(10/tick x the window)'.

title: SPRITE_COUNT comment still says the 5.11 sprites are 'not yet wired' — contradicted by this PR's own wiring
detail: The #65-era comment predates this PR's wiring and now contradicts the code directly below it; future readers are told the wiring 'belongs to story 5.11' while reading story 5.11's wiring.
recommended_fix: Update the SPRITE_COUNT comment to say the 5.11 sprites are wired via sprite_index_building (residential house/host/9 small_biz/10 campus), removing the 'not yet wired' clause.

title: W9 burst failure message hardcodes '(2 = ceil_cap)' though the re-pinned check is per-type (host 2, campus 3)
evidence: core/demand_test.odin:596-597: `testing.expectf(t, burst_ok, "no per-tick burst beyond the ceiling (2 = ceil_cap) may occur")` — while the check it reports on is now per-type (core/demand_test.odin:559-563): `acc := u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, s.topology.node_type[src_slot])); ceil_cap := (acc + 999) / 1000; if u64(n) > ceil_cap { burst_ok = false }`
detail: The message text still describes the pre-5.11 uniform ceiling of 2; on failure it would misreport a campus burst-3 violation (legal) or mask which type's ceiling fired.
recommended_fix: Change the message to name the per-type ceiling, e.g. 'no per-tick burst beyond the per-type ceiling (ceil(cap): host 2, campus 3) may occur'.
